description: With each person I met, each new culture I learned about and every new community I was immersed in, I couldn't ignore the many stories of people's lives that were not given the same, equal opportunity that I was afforded. Just because something worked for me in this country does not mean it works for everyone. I do my best to listen to all voices, especially those that are often silenced or ignored.
